scope: project-local contextual panels; opaque backgrounds require custom renderer; cutout-only library is not used

origin.prompt: Create a flat vector editorial illustration sheet on a solid #feee91 yellow background. A cozy reading desk with an orange angled desk lamp, purple closed book, sky-blue desk and empty chair. Strong geometrical cut-paper shapes, bold uniform #2d3436 charcoal outlines, absolutely flat solid fills with no gradients or lighting. Contemporary Swiss editorial infographic illustration, playful but sophisticated, no mascot or character. Landscape composition, large generous empty yellow margins. No words, numbers or symbols. Only 5 inks: yellow #feee91, orange #ffa239, purple #a594f9, cyan #8ce4ff, charcoal #2d3436. This will be displayed inside a yellow bento card.

review.reason: Simple lamp example is better served by icons; generated desk/blueprint assets were judged unnecessary and unsuitable. Do not reuse this treatment as a style precedent.

reviewHistory.notes: Desk/book environment fits topic. Opaque illustrated panel; slight raster tonal variation. Not a changing program state.
